name: Stun Grenade
descriptionLines: &7Flashbang that blinds and deafens anyone nearby.
&7Opens fights for you, but also affects you if you stand too close.

name: Flare Grenade
descriptionLines: &7Burns brightly to light up dark areas.
&7It reveals your position as well.

name: Smoke Grenade
descriptionLines: &7Thick smoke cloud that blocks line of sight.
&7Does no damage; use it to cover a push or a retreat.

name: Land Mine
descriptionLines: &7Buried explosive that goes off when stepped on.
&7Hurts allies too, so remember where you put it.

name: Tear Gas Grenade
descriptionLines: &7Tear gas that forces enemies out of cover.
&7Stay out of the cloud yourself or wear a gas mask.

name: Mustard Gas Grenade
descriptionLines: &7Very dangerous gas which kills enemies very fast

name: Choke Smoke Grenade
descriptionLines: &7Smoke that chokes anyone breathing it in.
&7Blocks vision and weakens enemies

name: Electric Grenade
descriptionLines: &7Discharges an electric pulse on detonation.
&7Shocks nearby players

name: Poison Grenade
descriptionLines: &7Releases a toxic cloud that poisons everyone inside.
&7Wears off quickly once the victim gets clear.

name: Pulse Grenade
descriptionLines: &7Only does destruction, doesn't damage players directly
&7Plentiful supply, but each blast is on the weak side.

name: Gas Grenade
descriptionLines: &7Releases a harmful gas cloud that denies the area.
&7A gas mask protects you from it.

name: Claymore Mine
descriptionLines: &7Directional mine that triggers when an enemy walks in front of it.
&7Sprays shrapnel forward only, so it is safe from behind.

name: Explosive Charge
descriptionLines: &7Place-and-detonate charge for breaking walls and trapping chokepoints.
&7Careful when placing it near your own position.

name: Cloud Grenade
descriptionLines: &7Releases a large lingering cloud over the area.
&7Anything caught inside suffers until the cloud fades.
&7Poisons the ground inside the cloud as well

name: Concussion Grenade
descriptionLines: &7Explodes in a big consussion blast, destroying and moving blocks
&7Doesn't damage players

name: Bouncing Betty
descriptionLines: &7Mine that pops into the air before exploding.
&7Wide damage radius and hard to spot once placed.

name: Sarin Gas Grenade
descriptionLines: &7Lethal nerve gas cloud that lingers for a long time.
&7Deadly in enclosed spaces and it does not care whose side you are on.

name: Healing Vapor Grenade
descriptionLines: &7Releases a healing gas cloud that mends everyone standing in it.
&7Heals enemies as well as allies.

name: Pink cloud Grenade
descriptionLines: &7Releases an even larger cloud (now pink!) over the area.
